name: Two-staged Space-Skipping with Bricking and Octrees
definition: A strategy to balance load on GPU bottlenecks by dividing space-skipping into two stages: coarse division using bricking to address bus and texture cache bottlenecks, and fine division using octrees within bricks to address the rasterization bottleneck.
summary: Two-staged Space-Skipping with Bricking and Octrees optimizes GPU volume rendering by combining coarse bricking for memory access with fine octree traversal for rasterization, enabling runtime transfer function changes without texture regeneration.
